name: Plan Evidence Led Content
summary: Build a content portfolio around audience decisions, distribution, evidence, and operating capacity.
description: Plan a content strategy that connects audience questions and business decisions to differentiated evidence, formats, distribution, ownership, and measurement. Use when a team needs a durable content portfolio rather than an unprioritized topic list.
risk_reason: This skill builds a content portfolio around audience decisions, distribution, evidence, and operating capacity; it does not manufacture a high-volume calendar from keyword tools alone.
refuses: It does not manufacture a high-volume calendar from keyword tools alone.
It does not copy competitor topics without a distinct audience need or evidence advantage.
It does not promise rankings, virality, pipeline, or attribution from publication volume.

operational.latency_reason: The skill builds a content portfolio around audience decisions, distribution, evidence, and operating capacity, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
